PROGRAM
  PREFIX_DECL
    KW_PREFIX "prefix"
    IDENT "ex"
    SHAPE_SEP ":"
    ABS_IRI "<https://example.org/>"
  MAPPING
    MAPPING_HEADER
      IDENT "User"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      SHAPE_EXPR
        IRI_EXPR
          IDENT "ex"
          SHAPE_SEP ":"
          IDENT "Person"
      KW_FROM "from"
      EXPR
        LITERAL_EXPR
          IDENT "users"
    MAPPING_BODY
      PROPERTY
        PROPERTY_LHS
          IRI_EXPR
            IDENT "ex"
            SHAPE_SEP ":"
            IDENT "author"
        ASSIGN "="
        EXPR
          RECORD_LITERAL
            LBRACE "{"
            RECORD_FIELD
              IDENT "name"
              ASSIGN "="
              FIELD_REF_EXPR
                DOT "."
                IDENT "author"
            COMMA ","
            RECORD_FIELD
              IDENT "year"
              ASSIGN "="
              LITERAL_EXPR
                INTEGER "2026"
            RBRACE "}"
